import json, tomllib, pathlib

in_py = pathlib.Path('/inputs/pyproject.toml')
in_dev = pathlib.Path('/inputs/devcontainer.json')
out = pathlib.Path('/work/devcontainer.json')

pyproj = tomllib.loads(in_py.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
project_name = pyproj['project']['name']
project_slug = project_name.lower().replace(' ', '-').replace('_', '-')

obj = json.loads(in_dev.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

# Replace placeholders in all string values

def replace_placeholders(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        return {k: replace_placeholders(v) for k, v in x.items()}
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return [replace_placeholders(v) for v in x]
    if isinstance(x, str):
        return x.replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}', project_name).replace('{{PROJECT_SLUG}}', project_slug)
    return x

obj = replace_placeholders(obj)

# Apply Python-specific edits
customizations = obj.setdefault('customizations', {})
vscode = customizations.setdefault('vscode', {})
extensions = vscode.setdefault('extensions', [])
extensions.extend([
    'ms-python.python',
    'ms-python.vscode-pylance',
    'charliermarsh.ruff',
])

settings = vscode.setdefault('settings', {})
settings['python.defaultInterpreterPath'] = '.venv/bin/python'
settings['[python]'] = {
    'editor.defaultFormatter': 'charliermarsh.ruff',
    'editor.codeActionsOnSave': {
        'source.organizeImports': 'explicit'
    }
}

obj['postCreateCommand'] = 'rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py'

out.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

# Validate output JSON parses
json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print('wrote', out)
print('project_name', project_name)
print('project_slug', project_slug)
